summary: No operator website (Google lists none); Visit Fairmont CVB listing read (44 RV sites, many pull-through, electric/water/sewer, showers, laundry, dump, phone-only booking), Explore Minnesota 403. Google 4.4/192; RV Life avg_rate $28 ($$ tier). Passes presence + price. Not long-stay in character. Not waterfront kept. Pin OK. No published rate or season.
flags: Private price gate: no operator-posted rate. Price evidence is the RV Life $$ tier (avg_rate 28 in its listing data); the 2022 Campendium '$42' is too old to count. Under US$50 on every source seen; passes on the RV Life tier.
Presence: no website, but Google Maps open with 192 reviews and phone 507-728-8811 -> passes (presence + price rule). Google 4.4 / 192 reviews: above the 4.0 line.

Long-stay five tests: (1) nightly stays sold: yes (phone reservations, CVB listing aimed at travellers, 'RV Park Only'); (2) a price indicator: RV Life $$ only, no posted nightly rate; (3) imagery shows most pads empty and no decks, sheds or skirting; (4) no seasonal or monthly offer found anywhere read; (5) a quarter mile off I-90, a travel-stop location. Not long-stay in character, so test 2's posted-rate requirement does not apply.
Website: https://visitfairmontmn.com/listings/welcome-creek-campground/ is a CVB directory listing, but the operator has no site and Google lists none; keep it (no better link exists).
Season unread: no source read gives open dates.
Waterfront: keep not waterfront (imagery: pads in a shelterbelt-ringed lot beside farm fields; no water near).
Pin 43.67600,-94.61540 is at the office house; the RV loops are ~60-130 m south (Google's point 43.67577,-94.61483 is the entrance). OK.
